slides.title: Words in context: the ^^dictionary^^ is the trap
Cover the choices
slides.body: Read the sentence and predict your own word for the blank. *Then* look. The trap answer is a real meaning of the word — just not the meaning **this** sentence needs.

slides.stem: The scientist's approach was remarkably economical, using just three variables. "Economical" most nearly means ______.
slides.prompt: Three of these are about money. The sentence isn't. Comment yours.

slides.title: C — efficient
slides.body: *Inexpensive* is the dictionary bait — there's no money anywhere in the sentence. The context is doing a lot with only three variables: efficiency. Context beats definition.
